added_comments.text: Upstream retries (e.g. the shipping webhook firing twice) re-publish with the same event id, so dedupe on id rather than timing.

rationale: The agent removed the timing-window workaround entirely and replaced it with correct id-based idempotency dedup, and also fixed a double-subscription bug in NotificationSubscriber (constructor no longer double-calls init), which was the actual source of duplicate delivery — a genuine root-cause fix rather than an added special case. New tests cover retried webhook calls and distinct near-simultaneous events, and nothing touches the payment.failed opt-out override logic.
